name: Yoru no Kake Mahjong: Kateba Ano Ko to Hitobanjuu
original_name: 夜の賭け麻雀 勝てばあの娘と一晩中
source: Somewhere in Tokyo, in an exclusive mahjong Club. Rei is a clerk in this club. Her job is to play Mahjong with the guests. Players will operate Rei and play with 3 guests in the authentic Japanese Mahjong. Dead wall draw and Last tile from the wall... It all depends on your skills!!
